stock.description: K Cash Corp. Ltd. operates as a financial firm specializing in providing money lending services. The company facilitates access to unsecured credit, employing financial technology (fintech) to manage the entire process. This technologically integrated system streamlines various stages, including initial loan applications, comprehensive credit evaluations, the disbursement of funds, and subsequent repayment administration. Established in October 2006, the company maintains its principal office in Hong Kong.
